links.outcome: Patient-reported satisfaction across six domains with vs without ambient scribe use
links.effect: Ambient scribe use associated with higher odds of satisfaction with perceived time spent with provider (OR 1.13, 95% CI 1.01-1.26, p=0.033); no detectable differences in other domains.
links.quote: Patients whose provider used an ambient scribe had higher odds of reporting satisfaction with the perceived duration of time spent with the provider (OR = 1.13, 95% CI: 1.01-1.26, p = 0.033).

screen.reason: Empirical observational study evaluating the impact of real-world ambient AI scribe deployment on patient experience via post-visit surveys.
